summaryZh: Kiger 实验室研究细胞重塑时如何维持和组织细胞结构，重点关注脂质调控下的膜运输、自噬及免疫细胞和肌肉细胞功能。研究结合果蝇遗传学、细胞生物学实验和系统生物学方法，分析脂质激酶与磷酸酶活动如何影响细胞重塑。
researchQuestions: 细胞重塑时，脂质和膜运输过程如何组织动态细胞结构？
topics: 磷脂酰肌醇脂质调控与自噬

evidence.quote: Our laboratory is studying central roles for novel membrane trafficking processes, under control of spatiotemporal lipid regulation, that coordinate dynamic cell structure. Using a foundation in genetic and cell biology experiments in the fruit fly, Drosophila, we are linking specific lipid kinase and phosphatase activities to cell remodeling.

Our research is currently focused in three major areas: (1) roles for phosphoinositide lipid regulation in cellular remodeling, (2) roles for autophagy in cellular remodeling, and (3) systems-biology approaches to understand cellular remodeling.
To address these problems, we are investigating questions specific to the dynamic organization of two distinct cell types, immune cells and muscle cells.
